entities.name: Foreign Occupation and Reconstruction
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Brazilian and Argentine forces occupied Paraguay until 1876. The government sold vast tracts of public land to foreign (mostly Argentine and Anglo-Argentine) corporations, creating the latifundia system that persists today. Women — who vastly outnumbered surviving men — became the backbone of nation
